mn102:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārame.
mn102:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn102:2.1: Santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇa aparantakappikā aparantānudiṭṭhino aparantaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhivuttipadāni abhivadanti.
mn102:2.2: Saññī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti
mn102:2.4: Asaññī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā ti
mn102:2.6: N' eva saññī nāsaññī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti
mn102:2.8: Sato vā pana sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññāpenti. Diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ vā pan' eke abhivadanti.
mn102:2.9: Iti santaṃ vā attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā. Sato vā pana sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññāpenti. Diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ vā pan' eke abhivadanti.
mn102:2.10: Iti imāni pañca hutvā tīṇi honti, tīṇi hutvā pañca honti.
mn102:3.1: Tatra, bhikkhave, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā; rūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā; arūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā; rūpiñ ca arūpiñ ca vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā; n' eva rūpiṃ nārūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā; ekattasaññiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññiṃ attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā; nānattasaññiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññiṃ attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā; parittasaññiṃ vā ti bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā; appamāṇasaññiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā. Etaṃ va pan' eke saṃ upātivattataṃ viññāṇakasiṇam eke abhivadanti appamāṇaṃ āṇañjaṃ.
mn102:4.2: Ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, rūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, arūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, rūpiñ ca arūpiñ ca vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, n' eva rūpiṃ vā nārūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, ekattasaññiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, nānattasaññim vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, parittasaññiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, appamāṇasaññiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā. Yā vā pan' esaṃ saññānaṃ parisuddhā paramā aggā anuttariyā akkhāyati
mn102:4.3: yadi rūpasaññānaṃ yadi arūpasaññānaṃ yadi ekattasaññānaṃ yadi nānattasaññānaṃ.
mn102:4.4: Na 'tthi kiñtīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ eke abhivadanti appamāṇaṃ āṇañjaṃ.
mn102:4.5: Tayidaṃ saṃkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ ; atthi kho pana saṃkhārānaṃ nirodho atth' etan ti
mn102:4.6: iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī Tathāgato tad upātivatto.
mn102:5.1: Tatra, bhikkhave, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā asaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, rūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā asaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, arūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā asaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, rūpiñ ca arūpiñ ca vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā asaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, n' eva rupiṃ nārūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā asaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā.
mn102:6.1: Tatra, bhikkhave, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, tesam eke paṭikkosanti.
mn102:6.3: Saññā rogo saññā gaṇḍo saññā sallaṃ, etaṃ santaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ asaññan ti.
mn102:7.2: Ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā asaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, rūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, arūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaña asaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, rūpiñ ca arūpiñ ca vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā asaññim attanaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, n' eva rūpiṃ nārūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā asaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā.
mn102:7.3: Yo hi koci, bhikkhave, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ vadeyya:
mn102:7.4: Aham aññatra rūpā aññatra vedanāya aññatra saññāya aññatra saṃkhārehi aññatra viññāṇassa āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā cutiṃ vā uppattiṃ vā vuddhiṃ vā virūḷhiṃ vā vepullaṃ vā paññāpessāmīti,
mn102:7.6: Tayidaṃ saṃkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ, atthi kho pana saṃkhārānaṃ nirodho atth' etan ti
mn102:7.7: iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī Tathāgato tad upātivatto.
mn102:8.1: Tatra, bhikkhave, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā nevasaññiṃ nāsaññim attānaṃ paññapenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, rūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā nevasaññiṃ nāsaññiṃ attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, arūpiṃ vā te samaṇabrāhmaṇā nevasaññiṃ nāsaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, rūpiñ ca arūpiñ ca vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā nevasaññiṃ nāsaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, nevarūpiṃ nārūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā nevasaññiṃ nāsaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā.
mn102:9.1: Tatra, bhikkhave, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, tesam eke patikkosanti. Ye pi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā asaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, tesam eke paṭikkosanti.
mn102:9.3: Saññā rogo saññā gaṇḍo saññā sallaṃ, asaññā sammoho; etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ
mn102:10.2: Ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā nevasaññiṃ nāsaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, rūpiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā nevasaññiṃ nāsaññiṃ attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, arūpiṃ te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā nevasaññim nāsaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, rūpiñ ca arūpiñ ca vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā nevasaññiṃ nāsaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, nevarūpiṃ nārupiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā nevasaññiṃ nāsaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā.
mn102:10.3: Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇabrāhmaṇā diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbassa saṃkhāramattena etassa āyatanassa upasampadaṃ paññāpenti; byasanaṃ h' etaṃ, bhikkhave, akkhāyati etassa āyatanassa upasampadāya;
mn102:10.4: na h' etaṃ, bhikkhave, āyatanaṃ sasaṃkhārasamāpattipattabbam akkhāyati
mn102:10.6: Tayidam saṃkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ, atthi kho pana saṃkhārānaṃ nirodho atth' etan ti
mn102:10.7: iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī Tathāgato tad upātivatto.
mn102:11.1: Tatra, bhikkhave, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā sato sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññāpenti, tatra, bhikkhave, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā, tesam eke paṭikkosanti; ye pi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā asaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti arogaṃ param maraṇā tesam eke paṭikkosanti; ye pi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā nevasaññiṃ nāsaññim attānaṃ paññāpenti, arogaṃ param maraṇā, tesam eke paṭikkosanti.
mn102:11.3: Sabbe p' ime bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā uddhaṃsarā āsattiṃ yeva abhivadanti:
mn102:11.4: Iti pecca bhavissāma, iti pecca bhavissāmāti.
mn102:12.1: Seyyathāpi nāma vāṇijassa vānijjāya gacchato evaṃ hoti:
mn102:12.2: Ito me idaṃ bhavissati, iminā idaṃ lacchāmīti, --
mn102:12.3: evam ev' ime bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā vāṇijūpamā maññe paṭibhanti:
mn102:12.4: Iti pecca bhavissāma iti pecca bhavissāmāti.
mn102:12.6: Ye kho te bhonte samaṇabrāhmaṇā sato sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññāpenti, te sakkāyabhayā sakkāyaparijegucchā, sakkāyañ ñeva anuparidhāvanti anuparivattanti.
mn102:12.7: Seyyathāpi nāma sāgaddūlabaddho daḷhe thambhe vā khīle vā upanibaddho tam eva thambaṃ vā khīlaṃ vā anuparidhāvati anuparivattati, --
mn102:12.8: evam ev' ime bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā sakkāyabhayā sakkāyaparijegucchā sakkāyañ ñeva anuparidhāvanti anuparivattanti.
mn102:12.9: Tayidaṃ saṃkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ , atthi kho pana saṃkhārānaṃ nirodho atth' etan ti
mn102:12.10: iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī Tathāgato tad upātivatto.

mn102:15.1: Tatra, bhikkhave, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:

mn102:21.2: Etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ upasampajja viharāmīti.
mn102:21.4: adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya nirodhā uppajjati nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ, nirāmisassa sukhassa nirodhā uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
mn102:22.1: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yaṃ chāyā jahati taṃ ātapo pharati; yaṃ ātapo jahati, taṃ chāyā pharati; --
mn102:22.2: evam eva kho, bhikkhave, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya nirodhā uppajjati nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ, nirāmisassa sukhassa nirodhā uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
mn102:22.4: Ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā pubbantānudiṭṭhīnañ ca paṭinissaggā aparantānudiṭṭhīnañ ca paṭinissaggā, sabbaso kāmasaṃyojanānaṃ anadhiṭṭhānā, pavivekāya pītiyā samatikkamā, nirāmisassa sukhassa samatikkamā, adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ upasampajja viharati:
mn102:22.5: Etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ upasampajja viharāmīti.
mn102:22.7: adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya nirodhā uppajjati nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ, nirāmisassa sukhassa nirodhā uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
mn102:22.8: Tayidaṃ saṃkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ, atthi kho pana saṃkhārānaṃ nirodho atth' etan ti
mn102:22.9: iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī Tathāgato tad upātivatto.
mn102:23.1: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā pubbantānudiṭṭhīnañ ca paṭinissaggā aparantānudiṭṭhīnañ ca paṭinissaggā, sabbaso kāmasaṃyojanānaṃ anadhiṭṭhānā, pavivekāya pītiyā samatikkamā, nirāmisassa sukhassa samatikkamā, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya samatikkamā,
mn102:23.2: Santo 'ham asmi, nibbuto 'ham asmi, anupādāno 'ham asmīti samanupassati.
mn102:24.2: Ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā . . . asmīti
mn102:24.4: addhā ayam āyasmā nibbānaṃ sappāyam eva paṭipadaṃ abhivadati.
mn102:24.5: Atha ca panāyaṃ bhavaṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā pubbantānudiṭṭhiṃ vā upādiyamāno upādiyati, aparantānudiṭṭhiṃ vā upādiyamāno upādiyati, kāmasaṃyojanaṃ vā upādiyamāno upādiyati, pavivekaṃ vā pītiṃ upādiyamāno upādiyati, nirāmisaṃ vā sukhaṃ upādiyamāno upādiyati, adukkhamasukhaṃ vā vedanaṃ upādiyamāno upādiyati.
mn102:24.7: Santo 'ham asmi, nibbuto 'ham asmi, anupādāno 'ham asmīti samanupassati, tad ap' imassa bhoto samaṇabrāhmaṇassa upādānam akkhāyati.
mn102:24.8: Tayidaṃ saṃkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ, atthi kho pana saṃkhārānaṃ nirodho atth' etan ti
mn102:24.9: iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī Tathāgato tad upātivatto.
mn102:25.1: Idaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, Tathāgatena anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ abhisambuddhaṃ yadidaṃ
mn102:25.2: channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañ ca atthaṅgamañ ca assādañ ca ādīnavañ ca nissaraṇañ ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimokkho. Tayidaṃ, bhikkhave, Tathāgatena anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ abhisambuddhaṃ yadidaṃ channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañ ca atthaṅgamañ ca assādañ ca ādīnavañ ca nissaraṇañ ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimokkho ti.
mn102:25.4: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun ti. 103.
